sections.title: Seed data by copy and paste
body: Every environment needs the same lookup values. Usually they arrive by a script someone runs once, or a dump nobody can diff.

sections.title: Files in, procedures run
body: dbd import loads staging data from CSV, TSV, JSON and JSONL files under import/, then calls the procedures that read it, so the logic for merging into real tables stays in SQL you own. dbd export writes table data back out to files.

sections.title: Reviewable, repeatable
body: Seed data becomes a diff in a pull request, and every environment gets the same values the same way.
points: Your procedures decide how rows merge
